name: Default
shortDescription: Single-node Apache CouchDB document database with its HTTP/JSON API, the Fauxton web dashboard at /_utils and persistent data and configuration.

alerts.message: Open https://<your-domain>/_utils and sign in as admin with the generated COUCHDB_PASSWORD from the environment variables. The admin is written to the persistent configuration on the first start, so changing the variable later has no effect; change the password in Fauxton instead.
